description: Check eligibility and credits for concept maps or Futures Wheels (graph_type), or retain a fully validated graph as a short-lived draft. The exact creation layout field is top-level graph.layout_intent, for example left-to-right. For concept maps, omission records Smart intent and complete explicit coordinates are preserved. Futures Wheels default to radial, derive positions with the wheel renderer, and reject other intents. Fields named layout, layout_type, or strategy are rejected. Drafts do not reserve credits and can be confirmed by draft ID without resending the graph.

graph_type.description: Choose a graph type explicitly. Futures wheels require exactly one order-0 center, parent_id/order metadata on every consequence, and causal edges forming one tree through five orders. Only radial layout is supported for wheels.

layout_intent.description: Requested semantic layout. Use this exact top-level field. If omitted, KnowMapped automatically applies Smart layout unless every node supplies explicit x/y coordinates; complete explicit coordinates are preserved as manual positioning. For futures_wheel the default is radial, positions are always derived, and non-radial intent is rejected.

semantic_data.description: For futures_wheel: futures_wheel.order is 0 for the unique center or 1–5 for consequences; futures_wheel.parent_id is null for the center, otherwise the source node ID. Center futures_wheel.domains contains up to 32 {id,label} entries; only order 1 may set domain_id. collapsed is a boolean beside futures_wheel. status is possible/assumption/evidence (not a fact check).

presentation.description: Non-layout visual settings. Layout belongs in top-level layout_intent.
